start: Members > Import, owner of a gym with two or more branches, one sheet with a column naming each member's branch

steps.action: Tap 'Choose file' and pick the sheet
user_sees: The columns matched, with a Branch column (found by its name or because its cells are branch names)
'Branches in your file': each name once, with its row count and the branch it matched
must_not: A column of members' home addresses taken as the Branch column
Blank or totals rows counted

steps.action: For a name that fits no branch, pick a branch
user_sees: '1 name matches none of your branches. Pick a branch for it, or pick “Skip these rows”.' goes away once picked
must_not: Those rows put into the open branch without asking
A name that fits two branches matched to one silently

user_sees: How many rows each branch gets (to add, already members); duplicates are checked against that branch's own members
must_not: A member called 'already a member' because another branch has the mobile
Batches of one branch offered for another

user_sees: Progress, then the result branch by branch (the open branch first)
'Each branch has its own “Past imports” list on this page. To undo what went into another branch, switch to that branch and open this page there.'
must_not: A member saved into the wrong branch
One branch's failure stopping the other branches
A member added twice

start: Members > Import, a gym with several branches, a workbook with one sheet per branch

steps.action: Choose the file and the first sheet
user_sees: A branch to pick for this sheet, with the branch whose name matches the sheet's name already picked
must_not: The sheet imported into the open branch without showing which branch
Rows of this sheet in any other branch

user_sees: The next sheet, with its own branch pick
must_not: A sheet already imported offered again
The first sheet's branch kept for the next sheet without matching its name

start: Import with a Branch column where some rows cannot be routed

steps.action: Leave a row with no branch written
user_sees: On the row: 'No branch is written on this row. Pick the branch for it under “Branches in your file”.'
must_not: The row added to the open branch
The row dropped without a reason

steps.action: Route rows to a branch that cannot be opened
user_sees: 'The branch “<name>” could not be opened: <why>' or 'The branch “<name>” is still opening. Wait a moment.'
must_not: The Add button counting those rows as ready

steps.action: Tap Add while one branch fails to open at save time
user_sees: '<branch> could not be opened: <why> Its rows are waiting below. Tap “Try again”.'
must_not: Those rows reported as added
Rows of the other branches held back

start: Members > Import in a gym with one branch, a file that has a 'Branch' column

user_sees: No 'Branches in your file' section; the Branch column is offered as an extra detail to keep
must_not: A branch question for a gym with one branch
Rows held back for a branch name

start: Import with a Branch column, one name set to 'Skip these rows'

steps.action: Pick 'Skip these rows' for one name
user_sees: Those rows are left out on purpose and no longer block the Add button
must_not: Skipped rows saved anyway

steps.action: Change the pick to a branch
user_sees: The rows come back as to add (or already members of that branch)
must_not: The rows staying skipped

steps.action: After a save where one branch waited, tap 'Try again'
user_sees: Only the waiting rows are sent; the result adds them to that branch's count, under the same import
must_not: Members already added sent again
A second 'Past imports' entry for the same file in that branch

steps.action: Switch to the other branch, open this page, tap 'Undo this import', then 'Yes, undo it'
must_not: Members of the first branch removed
No way to undo what went into the other branch

start: Members imported into two branches by the owner; a front desk added to branch A signs in

steps.action: As front desk of branch A, open Members
user_sees: Only the members that went into branch A
must_not: Members, mobiles or notes of branch B
Plans or payments from the file added by a front-desk login

steps.action: As the owner, check a member of branch B
user_sees: Aadhaar and PAN numbers are absent in every branch, the same as a one-branch import
must_not: An ID number kept in a branch that was not the open one
